description: Live cumulative group standings — pass a group letter A–L, or omit for all 12. Returns ranked rows (team, played, W/D/L, goal difference, points). Use get_today for fixtures/scores and get_next_fixture for one team. If unavailable, the default World Cup scope returns a roster at zero; competitions without a compatible bundled roster return no tables. Both are flagged degraded.

flavor.description: Commentary flair: off, subtle, full (default: full)

lang.description: Locale for dates, provider attribution, and commentary: en, es, pt, fr (the summary scaffold stays English; other locales fall back to en)

tz.description: IANA timezone for kickoff times, e.g. America/Mexico_City

name: get_standings
title: Group standings
